en.headline: Contemporary Fujian restaurant Quan opens in Central
en.dek: Chef Justin Yang’s new tasting-menu restaurant on the fifth floor of CCB Tower focuses on Fujian traditions through a modern lens, with dishes built around the five elements.
body: A new contemporary Chinese restaurant named Quan has opened on the fifth floor of CCB Tower in Central, led by chef Justin Yang.

The kitchen draws on Fujian culinary traditions and structures its tasting menus around the five elements. Dishes highlighted by the restaurant include chilled mantis shrimp topped with sea urchin, refined stocks and seafood compositions.
The venue is located at 5/F, CCB Tower, 3 Connaught Road Central. Reservations can be made by telephone on 2115 3388.

zh.headline: 中環新餐廳Quan主打現代福建菜
zh.dek: 主廚Justin Yang於中銀大廈五樓開設以福建傳統為本的試菜餐廳，菜單按五行結構設計。
body: 中環中銀大廈五樓新開設當代中菜餐廳Quan，由主廚Justin Yang主理。
廚房以福建傳統為基礎，試菜菜單按五行結構編排。餐廳推介的菜式包括海膽伴凍螳螂蝦、精煉高湯及多款海鮮組合。
地址為中環干諾道中3號中銀大廈5樓，電話2115 3388。
